chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 417: Ji Ning Tanks Nine Heavens Divine-Poison Flame – Black Mist Cave Trap
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning ignores a mountain-sized True Fire formation and uses the Bashe as a living hostage, forcing the Bloodcloud Hall into a desperate last resort—a cave that has killed Celestial Immortals.
og_title: Ji Ning Laughs Off Divine Poison Fire & Faces a Celestial-Immortal-Killing Cave
og_description: Ji Ning tanks a True Fire grand formation designed to threaten Celestial Immortals, forcing the assassins to flee into a mysterious death trap.
twitter_title: Ji Ning: "This Divine Poison Fire is like a warm bath" – Ch. 417
twitter_description: Ji Ning tanks a True Fire formation threatening Celestial Immortals and forces Bloodcloud Hall assassins into a mysterious death cave.

lore_anchors.definition: A chaotic, vile True Fire of mixed elemental power; cannot be nurtured within an immortal's body and is considered a dangerous, uncontrollable flame that requires a grand formation to deploy.
An ancient python-like divine beast capable of growing to thousands of zhang. It is a common transformation for high-level cultivators in combat.
A legendary supreme divine ability in the Three Realms, known for granting its user an indestructible body; only a few top Daofathers possess and teach it to their personal disciples.
A rare one-use talisman that allows instant, cross-realm teleportation; essential for escaping from a sealed space or dangerous realm.
A cultivator's personal mobile dwelling and treasure; can be used to hide from attacks but leaves the cultivator vulnerable to spatial sealing or being sent to a dangerous location.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Ji Ning able to ignore the Nine Heavens Divine-Poison Flame?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His Fiendgod Body Refining has reached a tier where True Fire of this level causes negligible harm, implying he either possesses the legendary Eight-Nine Arcane Art or a Daofather-granted protective treasure of immense quality.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is special about the black misty cave?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a passage to a place tens of thousands to millions of times more dangerous than the Donglin Mountains, known to have killed Celestial Immortals who foolishly chased fleeing assassins into it.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Bloodcloud Hall use a Bashe as their fighter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Bashe is a classic high-level combat form that combines immense size, strength, and speed, making it a difficult opponent to suppress; it also serves as a distraction for their escape plan.
